findings.root_cause: The reviewed _execute_derived implementation mapped every input status other than resolved to typed_gap derived_formula_input_missing, including authoritative typed_conflict results from physical-period identity admission.
findings.impact: A disputed or unproved input identity could be reported downstream as missing public information. This violates the repository rule that retrieval or authority failures must not masquerade as genuine information boundaries.
findings.required_successor: If any formula input returns typed_conflict, the derived request must return typed_conflict and preserve the input side, metric, request id, conflict code, and nested conflicts. Only conflict-free missing inputs may produce a typed gap.

findings.root_cause: The reviewed candidate query admitted every period role before the empty-row fast path. When the requested role had no rows, an identity conflict belonging only to another role could cause _execute_direct to return conflict before _select_latest_period_roles filtered it.
findings.impact: A quarter-discrete request could receive a false conflict from an annual or instant row that was outside its requested granularity.
findings.required_successor: Constrain candidate rows to the roles admitted by the requested granularity before physical-period identity admission.
